# VICE

> Global digital media publisher covering investigative journalism, documentaries, news, culture, identity, entertainment, and lifestyle.

VICE publishes reported stories, videos, and features across world news, politics, technology, drugs, sex, music, fashion, sports, food, and youth culture, with regional editions and long-running verticals focused on underreported topics and emerging trends.

## Main Site

- [Homepage](https://www.vice.com/): Main entry point for VICE stories, videos, and featured reporting across all editorial categories.
- [Latest](https://www.vice.com/en/latest): Reverse-chronological feed of newly published articles and updates from across the site.
- [Video](https://www.vice.com/en/video): Hub for original documentaries, short films, interviews, and reported video journalism.
- [About VICE](https://www.vice.com/en/page/about-vice): Overview of VICE, its editorial mission, and company background.
- [Contact](https://www.vice.com/en/page/contact): Contact information and submission paths for editorial and general inquiries.
- [Newsletters](https://www.vice.com/en/newsletters): Newsletter signup page for recurring editorial updates and curated stories.

## News & Investigations

- [News](https://www.vice.com/en/section/news): Reporting on world events, politics, conflict, crime, and current affairs.
- [World News](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/world-news): Stories focused on international events, geopolitics, and global developments.
- [Politics](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/politics): Coverage of elections, policy, government, ideology, and political culture.
- [Investigations](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/investigations): Deep reporting and accountability journalism on complex or underreported issues.
- [Crime](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/crime): Reporting on criminal justice, policing, organized crime, and legal cases.
- [Climate](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/climate): Coverage of climate change, environmental policy, and ecological impacts.

## Identity, Society & Life

- [Life](https://www.vice.com/en/section/life): Features on relationships, health, work, internet life, and everyday experiences.
- [Identity](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/identity): Reporting and essays on gender, sexuality, race, and personal identity.
- [Sex](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/sex): Articles about sexual culture, relationships, and sexual health.
- [Health](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/health): Coverage of mental health, public health, wellness, and medical issues.
- [Drugs](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/drugs): Reporting on drug policy, substance use, harm reduction, and drug culture.
- [Advice](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/advice): Service-oriented stories answering practical and personal questions.

## Culture & Entertainment

- [Culture](https://www.vice.com/en/section/culture): Features on internet culture, trends, creators, and contemporary cultural life.
- [Music](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/music): Reporting on artists, scenes, releases, and the music industry.
- [Entertainment](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/entertainment): Coverage of film, television, streaming, celebrities, and pop culture.
- [Art](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/art): Stories about visual art, artists, exhibitions, and creative practice.
- [Fashion](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/fashion): Reporting on style, designers, subcultures, and fashion industry trends.
- [Books](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/books): Interviews, criticism, and features on authors and publishing.

## Technology & Internet

- [Tech](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/tech): Coverage of consumer technology, platforms, startups, and digital life.
- [Internet](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/internet): Reporting on online communities, memes, platform culture, and web phenomena.
- [Science](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/science): Stories on research, discovery, space, and scientific developments.
- [AI](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/ai): Coverage of artificial intelligence, tools, policy, and cultural effects.
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/cybersecurity): Reporting on hacking, privacy, surveillance, and digital security.
- [Gaming](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/gaming): Features and reporting on games, players, and gaming culture.

## Food, Travel & Sports

- [Food](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/food): Stories about restaurants, cooking, food culture, and culinary trends.
- [Travel](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/travel): Features on destinations, travel culture, and reported journeys.
- [Sports](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/sports): Coverage of athletes, competitions, fan culture, and sports business.
- [Outdoors](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/outdoors): Reporting on nature, recreation, and environmental experiences.
- [Cities](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/cities): Stories centered on urban life, local culture, and city issues.

## Video & Documentary Brands

- [VICE Video](https://www.vice.com/en/video): Main video library for documentaries, explainers, and interviews.
- [VICE on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@vice): Official YouTube channel featuring documentaries, clips, and original series.
- [Dark Side of the Ring](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/dark-side-of-the-ring): Coverage and related content for the wrestling documentary franchise.
- [United Gangs of America](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/united-gangs-of-america): Related stories and video content tied to the documentary series.
- [The Story of](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/the-story-of): Documentary-style explainers on notable events, people, and phenomena.

## Regional Editions

- [United States](https://www.vice.com/en): English-language edition for U.S. and global coverage.
- [United Kingdom](https://www.vice.com/en_uk): UK edition with regionally relevant reporting and features.
- [Canada](https://www.vice.com/en_ca): Canadian edition covering domestic and international stories.
- [Australia](https://www.vice.com/en_au): Australian edition with local reporting and culture coverage.
- [Germany](https://www.vice.com/de): German-language edition of VICE.
- [France](https://www.vice.com/fr): French-language edition of VICE.
- [Netherlands](https://www.vice.com/nl): Dutch-language edition of VICE.
- [Italy](https://www.vice.com/it): Italian-language edition of VICE.

## Special Projects

- [Navigator](https://navigator.vice.com/): Branded city-guide project featuring local recommendations for European destinations.
- [Fund Our Fun](https://fundourfun.vice.com/): Advocacy project mapping UK clubs and venues affected by pandemic shutdowns.
- [Noisey](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/noisey): Music-focused VICE brand covering artists, scenes, and industry stories.
- [Munchies](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/munchies): Food-focused VICE brand covering recipes, restaurants, and food culture.
- [Waypoint](https://www.vice.com/en/topic/waypoint): Gaming-focused VICE brand covering games, criticism, and industry news.

## Corporate & Legal

- [Careers](https://www.vice.com/en/page/careers): Information about jobs and working at VICE.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.vice.com/en/page/privacy-policy): Privacy practices, data handling, and user rights information.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.vice.com/en/page/terms-of-use): Legal terms governing use of VICE websites and services.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.vice.com/en/page/cookie-policy): Details on cookies, tracking technologies, and user choices.
- [Accessibility](https://www.vice.com/en/page/accessibility): Accessibility statement and support information for site users.
